title: R-universality of the special linear Lie algebra over a central division algebra is exactly the split-or-quaternion condition
author: Dave Witte Morris
work: A Cohomological Proof that Real Representations of Semisimple Lie Algebras Have Q-Forms
source_version: Official SIGMA 11 (2015) article 034, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2015.034; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the classification of R-universality for the special linear Lie algebra over a central division algebra (author prop at source lines 541-545): it holds exactly when the division algebra is Q itself or a quaternion algebra that does not split over R. The proof (source lines 547-564) computes the Tits algebras at the powers of the highest weight of the standard representation as the tensor powers of the division algebra (proof lines 550-552), then reads the two implications off the author's division-algebra description of R-universality, using that the real Tits algebra is either R or the quaternions in the forward direction and that the square of a quaternion algebra is Brauer trivial in the converse (proof lines 554-563). The whole content is the Brauer-class computation and the parity split. H2.
